an4.2:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] catūhi bhikkhave, dhammehi asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:1.3: ariyena bhikkhave, sīlena asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:1.4: ariyena bhikkhave, samādhinā asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:1.5: ariyāya bhikkhave, paññāya asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:1.6: ariyāya bhikkhave, vimuttiyā asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:1.7: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi asamannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā papatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:2.1: catūhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:2.3: ariyena bhikkhave, sīlena samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:2.4: ariyena bhikkhave, samādhinā samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:2.5: ariyāya bhikkhave, paññāya samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:2.6: ariyāya bhikkhave, vimuttiyā samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito’ti vuccati.
an4.2:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato imasmā dhammavinayā appapatito’ti vuccatīti.
